Made by D.S. Moore Forwarded by [Signature]

Jacques Alfandry, a
The above named Hungarian subject arrived in Shanghai
from Colombo on May 8, 1932 and on that date took up residence
in the Pension R. Walter 14/15 Pacific Gardens, Seymour Road,
where he gave out that he was an engineer by profession. He
resided at this address until October 12, 1932, when he left,
owing the sum of $500 and took up quarters in another boarding
house at No.1 Pacific Gardens. He left the latter place on
December 1, 1932 and is now living at a boarding house situated
at 72 Carter Road.

Alfandry is a man of about 64 years of age and has
given out that his wife is dead and his two children are still
at school in his native place, Budapest. Following his arrival
in this city, he is alleged to have stated that he had been
advisor to the Government of Afghanistan where he still had a
considerable sum of money which he was unable to touch. Further
that he had travelled extensively in Persia and Egypt. He pro-
pounded several grandiose schemes relating to the supply of
machinery and machine spare parts to firms in the Far East and
in this connection conducted an extensive correspondence with
a Mr. Kemeny in his native country. In spite of his assurances
that he would soon be engaged in a lucrative engineering busi-
ness, Alfandry was always deficient of ready cash and has on
numerous occasions received financial support from local Hun-
garian charitable organizations. In this connection he met
Mr. Paul Komar, of the Transocean Hide and Products Co, Room
631, No.19 Museum Road, the local unofficial representative of
the Hungarian Government. Mr. Komar, thereupon communicated
with sources, which he considers absolutely reliable, in Hun-
gary, and received the assurance that Alfandry's correspondent

撰写人 D.S. 摩尔 转呈人 [签名]

雅克·阿尔凡德里，一名
上述匈牙利籍人员于1932年5月8日从科伦坡抵达上海，并于当日入住西摩路太平洋花园14/15号的R.沃尔特公寓（Pension R. Walter），声称其职业为工程师。他一直居住在该地址，直至1932年10月12日，因拖欠500美元款项而离开，随后搬入太平洋花园1号的另一家寄宿公寓。他于1932年12月1日离开后者，现居住在卡特路72号的一家寄宿公寓内。

阿尔凡德里年约64岁，声称其妻子已故，两名子女仍在故乡布达佩斯上学。据称，他在抵达本市后曾表示，他曾担任阿富汗政府顾问，在那里仍有一大笔资金但他无法动用。此外，他还曾在波斯和埃及广泛游历。他提出了一些宏大的计划，涉及向远东地区的公司提供机械及机器备件，并为此与其祖国的凯梅尼（Kemeny）先生进行了大量的通信往来。尽管他保证很快就会从事利润丰厚的工程业务，但阿尔凡德里总是缺乏现金，并曾多次接受当地匈牙利慈善组织的经济资助。在此过程中，他结识了博物馆路19号631室跨洋皮货及产品公司（Transocean Hide and Products Co）的保罗·科马尔（Paul Komar）先生，后者是匈牙利政府在当地的非官方代表。科马尔先生随即与他认为绝对可靠的匈牙利方面来源取得联系，并得到保证，阿尔凡德里的通信对象

in Budapest, Mr. Kemeny, is a highly respected and bona-fide
business man, but that Aliandry is, on general grounds, an
undesirable and that every effort should be made to deport him
from China. Further, that it was suspected he was engaged in
arms dealing whilst in Afghanistan. In the absence of any
definite complaint and in view of the fact that Hungarians
are under the jurisdiction of the Chinese Government, Mr. Kamar
has been unable to take any action against Alfandry.

Jacques Alfandry is on terms of intimacy with a
Chinese named Loo, who states that he was for 8 years a member
of the Salt Gabelle at Tsingtao afterwards being transferred
to the Chinese Maritime Customs service in Shanghai. He pro-
fesses to have served in the Customs for 22 years and to have
recently retired. Alfandry and Loo recently visited the local
Netherlands Consulate-General and endeavoured to have signa-
tures on a contract, made legal. The nature of the business
was not stated, but the gist of the contract referred to the
division of profits. At this interview, Alfandry produced
lists of machinery, machine guns, machine gun spare parts and
tripods, together with photographs of the same. It was stated
that any business conducted would be strictly within the law
and if referring to arms would be covered by genuine "huchao".
The Netherlands Consulate-General refused to legalise the con-
tract and advised the man Loo to first have his signature
legalised by the Bureau of Social Affairs, before any action
could be taken. Loo and Alfandry agreed to this stating that
they would return the following day. This they failed to do.

The Chinese named Loo, has also, at the instigation
of Alfandry, given out that he is desirous of starting a cigar

在布达佩斯的凯梅尼先生是一位备受尊敬且信誉良好的商人，但阿尔凡德里总体上是一个不受欢迎的人，应尽一切努力将其驱逐出中国。此外，有人怀疑他在阿富汗期间从事军火交易。由于没有任何明确的投诉，且鉴于匈牙利人受中国政府管辖，科马尔先生无法对阿尔凡德里采取任何行动。

雅克·阿尔凡德里与一名姓陆（Loo）的中国人关系密切，陆某声称他曾在青岛盐务稽核所任职8年，随后调任上海中国海关服务。他自称在海关服役22年，最近刚退休。阿尔凡德里和陆某最近访问了当地荷兰总领事馆，试图使合同上的签名合法化。业务的性质未予说明，但合同的要点涉及利润分配。在这次面谈中，阿尔凡德里出示了机械、机枪、机枪备件和三脚架的清单，以及这些物品的照片。据称，任何进行的业务都将严格在法律范围内，如果涉及武器，将持有真正的“护照”（huchao，即许可证）。荷兰总领事馆拒绝公证该合同，并建议陆某先在社会局公证其签名，然后才能采取任何行动。陆某和阿尔凡德里同意了这一要求，并表示第二天会回来。但他们并未履行承诺。

CONFIDENTIAL

December 8, 1932.
H.305
8 12 32

A.C. (Special Branch)
Superintendent i/c C. I. Inf.

Please have confidential enquiries made
with reference to a man named Jacob Alxandry,
occupation Civil Engineer, Hungarian, who speaks
German, Hungarian and perhaps Russian.

This man called at the Netherlands Consulate
together with a Chinese who spoke German and English
and stated that he had been an Inspector in Salt Gabelle.
Alxandry stated that he wanted to legalise the
signature on a contract. The nature of the contract
not known - probably refers to drugs, or arms etc.
This man is stated to be of an undesirable type and is
probably concerned in attempting to obtain money by
false pretences. He has received financial charitable
assistance from Hungarian societies in Shanghai. He
does not speak very much English, but stated that he had
been adviser to the Government of Afghanistan and had
travelled in Persia and Egypt.. He has resided at the
Pension R.Walter 15-16 Pacific Gardens (card attached)
where he owes a bill of $800.

Mr. Walter may be able to give this man's
present address.

Copy of Alxandry's signature is attached.

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

page_data.en:
"AZ EST" 10-5-'33 Budapest.

The name of Alfandri is not unknown in Budapest. There
is an official record of a certain Jacob Alfrandri, Agent,
who was repeatedly sentenced to short and longer terms of
imprisonment for swindling. He was born in Temesvar, by re-
ligion a Jew, married and by profession an Agent. His doings
are well known in Hungary since quite sometime. In the Au-
tumn of 1922 the "Futura" sent him to Soviet Russia for the
purpose of securing business but Jacob Alfandri, with the
letter of recommendation (from the "Futura") in his hands,
engaged in a number of different swindles.

His last appearance before the Lawcourts of Budapest was
in 1923 and he was then sentenced, under No.BVIII 2619/323,
to one year's imprisonment for false pretences (Swindling).
After serving his sentence, Alfandri went to Egypt from where,
leaving very considerable debts behind him, he absconded.
According to reports received in Budapest, he has transferred
the scene of his activities to Bombay.

《Az Est》 1933年5月10日 布达佩斯。

阿尔凡德里（Alfandri）这个名字在布达佩斯并不陌生。官方记录显示，有一名名为雅各布·阿尔弗兰德里（Jacob Alfrandri）的代理商，曾因诈骗多次被判处短期和长期监禁。他出生于泰梅什堡（Temesvar），犹太教徒，已婚，职业为代理商。他的行径在匈牙利早已为人所知。1922年秋，“Futura”公司派他前往苏维埃俄罗斯以争取业务，但雅各布·阿尔凡德里手持“Futura”公司的推荐信，从事了多种不同的诈骗活动。

他最后一次出现在布达佩斯法庭是在1923年，当时他被判犯有虚假借口罪（诈骗），案号BVIII 2619/323，判处一年监禁。服刑期满后，阿尔凡德里前往埃及，在那里留下了巨额债务后潜逃。根据布达佩斯收到的报告，他已将活动范围转移至孟买。

感谢你方1933年5月10日的来信，信中包含关于雅克·阿尔凡德里的笔记，并随函附上一份警方报告副本，其中证实了部分笔记内容。

此致
敬礼

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
Special Branch S. 4.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / D. REGISTR / 4305）
Date ____ 1933.

Subject (in full) Jacques Alfandry (Hungarian). Netherlands Consulate re.

Made by ____ and ____ Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

With reference to the attached Communications from
the Netherlands Consulate regarding the proposed building of
a factory opposite Yangtsepoo Police Station by Jacques Al-
fandry, enquiries show that on March 14, 1933, Alfandry ob-
tained from the Public Works Department a permit to erect a
bamboo fence around a piece of ground at the corner of Chao-
yang and Seoul Roads, about 500 yards north of Yangtsepoo
Police Station.

The site is Cadastral Lot 7460 and is registered
under the name of Lester, Johnson, & Morris as B.C. 7179.

Alfandry told the Public Works Department that he
intended to build a Tannery on the site, but so far, only the
bamboo fence has been erected.

D. S. I.
（签名：D.S.I. Moore）

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
特科 S. 4.
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / D. 登记处 / 4305）
日期 ____ 1933年。

主题（全称） 雅克·阿尔凡德里（匈牙利人）。荷兰领事馆事宜。

撰写人 ____ 和 ____ 转呈人 D.S.I. 摩尔。

关于附件中荷兰领事馆就雅克·阿尔凡德里拟在杨树浦警察局对面建造工厂一事进行的沟通，调查显示，1933年3月14日，阿尔凡德里从工务局获得许可，在朝阳路与首尔路（Seoul Roads）拐角处的一块土地周围搭建竹篱笆，该地位于杨树浦警察局以北约500码处。

该地块为地籍编号7460，以莱斯特、约翰逊和莫里斯公司（Lester, Johnson, & Morris）的名义注册，注册号为 B.C. 7179。

阿尔凡德里告诉工务局，他打算在该地块建造一家制革厂，但到目前为止，仅搭建了竹篱笆。

D. S. I.
（签名：D.S.I. 摩尔）

特科主管警官。

SHANGHAI, 7th January 1933.

Sir,

With reference to your letter of 20 December 1932
No.D.4305, concerning Jacques Alfandry, I have the honour
to inform you that this person appears now to be connected
with Lu Ta & Co. (蘆達公司), Engineering Department,

The name of Alfandri is not unknown in Budapest, There 
is an official record of a certain Jacob Alfrandri, Agent, 
who was repeatedly sentencéd to short and longer torms of 
imprisonment for swindling. He was born in Temesvar, by re- 
ligion a Jew, married and by profession an Agent. His doings 
are well known in Hungary since qui’e sometime, In the 4v- 
tumn of 1922 the "Futuza” sent him to Soviet Russia for the 
purpose of securing business but Jacob Alfandri, with the 
letter of recommendation (from the "Futura") in his hands, 
engaged in a number of different swindles, 


His last appearance before the Lawcourts of Budapest was 
in 1923 and he was then sentenced, under No.BVIII 2619/823, 
to one-year's imprisonment for false pretences (Swindling). 
After serving his sentence, Alfandri went to Egypt from where, 
leaving very considerable debts behind him, he absconded. 
According to reports received in Budapest, he has transferred 
the scene of his activities to Bombay.
